description: On the green tablecloth there’s a small stack of colorful plastic saucers near the right side. The right hand reaches in and lifts the top blue saucer off the stack, slides it to the far right and releases it, then separates the remaining saucers by pulling a yellow saucer out to the left and setting it down, and finally lifts and shifts a red saucer forward, revealing a green saucer beneath as the stack is unstacked.
